Create a mobile UX/layout implementation for Racing26 where the on-screen steering wheel replaces the two arrow steering buttons as the DEFAULT steering control. Focus on thumb ergonomics, safe-area handling, portrait/landscape sizing, visual hierarchy, unobstructed road view, pedal coexistence, one-handed reach, and clear pressed/active feedback. The wheel should rotate visually with the user's drag and be easy to acquire without requiring pixel-perfect touches. Keep the UI restrained and game-like, not toy/cartoon. Also make the driving page globally non-highlightable/non-draggable where appropriate so players can drag around the screen without selecting text or images; preserve accessibility/controls that still need taps. Avoid changing physics. Add/update mobile tests and CSS. Propose a concrete patch.
